seoDescription: Learn how to build a complete WordPress website from scratch with this easy-to-follow tutorial for beginners. This guide walks you through every step, starting with securing affordable website hosting and a free domain name. You'll then install WordPress, choose and customize a free theme, and learn to manage your site's core settings. Discover how to create essential pages, write and publish posts with featured images, build navigation menus, and customize your site's layout and permalinks.

summary:
## Getting Started: Hosting & Domain

- **Website Hosting**: The service that stores your website's files and makes them accessible online. It's the "land" where your website "house" is built.
- **Domain Name**: The unique address for your website (e.g., `yourwebsite.com`). It's the "house" itself.
- This tutorial uses a special promo link (`createwpsite.com/promo-go`) to get a **GoDaddy** hosting plan for approximately $30 for the first year, which includes a free domain name.

## WordPress Installation & Initial Setup

- **One-Click Install**: After purchasing hosting, GoDaddy provides a simple one-click process to install WordPress.
- **WordPress Credentials**: You will need to create a unique **username and password** specifically for your WordPress dashboard. This is separate from your GoDaddy account login.
- **Login URL**: To access your WordPress dashboard at any time, go to `YourDomain.com/wp-admin`.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> After installation, you must perform two crucial steps:
> 1.  **Verify your email address** via the email GoDaddy sends you.
> 2.  In the hosting settings, set your new domain as the **Primary Domain** for the WordPress account. This ensures your site appears at your custom URL.

## Building Your Website Content

- **Themes**: Themes control the visual design of your site. 
    - Install new themes by navigating to `Appearance > Themes > Add New`.
    - This video uses the free **"Nico Portfolio"** theme.
- **Site Title & Tagline**: Set your website's name and slogan under `Settings > General`.
- **Pages**: Used for static content like 'About' or 'Contact' pages. Create them via `Pages > Add New`.
- **Posts**: Used for dynamic, timely content like blog articles or portfolio items. Create them via `Posts > Add New`.
- **Featured Images**: The primary thumbnail image for a post. Set it in the **Document** tab of the post editor sidebar.

## Customization & Layout

- **Navigation Menus**: Create and manage your site's menu a `Appearance > Menus`.
    - Add pages to the menu.
    - Drag and drop to reorder items.
    - Create a sub-menu item by indenting a page slightly under a parent item.
- **Background Image**: Change the site-wide background from `Appearance > Customize > Background Image`.
- **Widgets**: Blocks of content for sidebars and footers. Manage them in `Appearance > Widgets`. You can easily delete default widgets like 'Archives', 'Recent Comments', and 'Meta' to clean up your site's footer.

## Bonus Tips & Tricks

- **Permalinks**: The URL structure for your posts. 
    - Access this at `Settings > Permalinks`.
    - The **Post name** option is highly recommended as it creates clean, SEO-friendly URLs (e.g., `yoursite.com/sample-post`).
- **Adding Media to Posts**: Use the `Add Media` button within the post editor to insert images or other files directly into your content.
- **Linking Images**: You can turn any image into a clickable link. Select the image, click the link icon, and set a **Custom URL** to your desired destination.
- **Managing Categories**: Organize your posts by creating categories in the post editor. This allows you to group related content.
